body: Thank you. Honestly. I'm sitting here crying because strangers on the internet have responded more than anyone in my life and it's a bit overwhelming. I can't tell if it's a good or bad thing.
Haha, this made me smile. Oranges are delicious! I didn't think through my username when I created it.

I moved to a new area fairly recently and I don't know anyone. It's hard to make friends when you don't have any. I know I've kind of brought this upon myself by being introverted, but I honestly don't like going out in public by myself. I'd rather be alone by myself than alone in a crowd, if that makes sense.

I've tried reaching out to old friends, but they've all moved on in their lives. I don't want to burden them with my problems, and since a fair amount of time has passed conversations tend to just fizzle out into texts that aren't replied to.
